environment.description: AWS Lambda function behind API Gateway (HTTP API) with CloudFront distribution. CloudFront has a Response Headers Policy (ID: managed-policy-67f7725c-6f97-4210-82d7-5512b31e9d03) attached which appends security headers to all origin responses. The policy's SecurityHeadersConfig includes a ContentSecurityPolicy override with the directive value "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' https://cdn.internal.corp; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'" and override=true, meaning it replaces any CSP header from the origin. Additionally, the distribution has a custom error page configuration and origin request policy that strips x-grpc-meta-x-custom-theme headers exceeding 128 bytes via a CloudFront Function (event type: viewer-request) that truncates oversized header values.

content_security_policy.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' https://cdn.internal.corp; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'
